# Denver7

> Denver7 is Colorado's leading local news source providing breaking news, weather, traffic, and sports coverage for the Denver metro area and Front Range.

Denver7 delivers comprehensive news coverage across local, state, national, and international topics with specialized sections for weather, traffic, sports, and regional issues affecting Colorado residents. The site serves as a primary news hub for the Denver metropolitan area with real-time updates on breaking news, weather conditions, and traffic alerts.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Local News
- Denver Metro
- Front Range
- Colorado News
- Weather Forecasts
- Traffic Alerts
- Denver Sports
- Colorado Politics
- Crime Reports
- National News
- Business News
- Education
- Environment
- Community Issues

## News Hub

- [News](https://www.denver7.com/news): Breaking news hub for Denver metro, Colorado, and national coverage
- [Local News](https://www.denver7.com/news/local-news): Latest Denver and Colorado breaking news, headlines, and local stories
- [State News](https://www.denver7.com/news/state-news): Colorado state news covering politics, budget, and statewide issues
- [National News](https://www.denver7.com/news/national-news): Breaking and developing national news from across the United States
- [World News](https://www.denver7.com/world-news): Breaking world news and international coverage from Denver7

## Real-Time Alerts

- [Weather](https://www.denver7.com/weather): Denver weather forecasts, radar, and conditions for Front Range Colorado
- [Traffic](https://www.denver7.com/traffic): Traffic alerts and road conditions for Denver metro and Front Range

## Sports & Entertainment

- [Sports](https://www.denver7.com/sports): Denver sports news covering Broncos, Nuggets, and local Colorado teams

## Government & Politics

- [Politics News](https://www.denver7.com/news/politics): Colorado politics news from state Capitol, Congress, and local government
- [Crime](https://www.denver7.com/news/crime): Crime and courts news for Denver metro and Colorado Front Range

## Specialized Coverage

- [Business News](https://www.denver7.com/money/business-news): Colorado business news covering local companies and economic updates
- [Education News](https://www.denver7.com/lifestyle/education): Education news for Denver Public Schools and Colorado higher education
- [Environment](https://www.denver7.com/news/environment): Environmental news on Colorado water, wildlife, and sustainability
- [Marijuana News](https://www.denver7.com/news/local-news/marijuana): Colorado marijuana and cannabis industry news and regulations

## Optional

- [Coronavirus](https://www.denver7.com/news/coronavirus): COVID-19 and coronavirus coverage for Colorado and global updates
